overview_description.description: Zest Equity is a financial technology company that provides software and infrastructure for managing private market transactions. The platform is used to structure and process investment deals such as private equity investments, venture capital rounds, and secondary share transfers. It supports the creation of special purpose vehicles , investor onboarding, document signing, and handling of capital flows through digital workflows.

product.name: SPV Formation and Management
product.description: Digital creation and administration of special purpose vehicles that consolidate investors for private-market transactions, including fundraising, co-investments, syndicates, and cap-table simplification.

product.name: Escrow Services
product.description: Regulated escrow infrastructure for collecting, holding, and releasing private-market transaction funds when specified contractual conditions are satisfied.

product.name: Private-Market Capital Distribution
product.description: Infrastructure for distributing private-market investment opportunities and facilitating capital flows through regulated channels serving professional investors and deal makers.
